title: The Space calendar's Pencil it in sheet, quick add and command bar

source.ref: Daniel, 2026-10-28: redesign the Space calendar with the Calendar system handoff; every Space gets the full calendar and project suite (pass 6 of 9)

detail: Pass 6 of the Space calendar and project suite: the three ways to make something. Pencil it in is a sheet that holds up to three dates for 3, 7 or 14 days (the hold lives on the Plan, space_plans.hold_until from pass 2), with a playbook picker that lays down a Plan's to-dos; quick add is a small popover opened by clicking an empty time on Week or Day or a day on Month, taking a title and making a to-do, a private block or a Pencil; the command bar (Ask Vera or search, or /) parses a line such as 'pencil supper friday 6pm', previews what it understood and adds nothing until Enter on the create row, and also opens views, jumps to a date and finds a Plan or a date by name. A failed create keeps the bar open and says why. Every write goes through the new pencil-actions.ts (pencilItIn, addQuickItem), which reuse the calendar's existing writes, and each create offers Undo through the same toast. Pure logic with tests: pencil-it-in.ts and command-results.ts. Releasing lapsed holds is pass 8, not here. Plan: /mnt/project-files/calendar-suite/PLAN.md.

verify.note: Fails on main (no Pencil it in sheet, quick add or command bar); passes here. The parsing and results tests run in CI.
